Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his expression firm but concerned 😬.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 💊."

JACK:
"I don't want it. I don't need it. I'm fine." 🙅‍♂️

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you know as well as I do that you're not fine. You're sick, and this medication is the only thing that can help you 🤕."

JACK:
"I don't need your help. I can take care of myself." 💪

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, but I'm not leaving until you take it. I'll even hold your hand if I have to 🤗."

JACK:
"Go ahead, then. But you'll see, it's not worth it." 😏

Dr. Smith hesitates for a moment, then reaches out and forces the medication into Jack's mouth 🤢. Jack spits it out, but Dr. Smith insists, holding his jaw shut until the pill is down 🤯.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a file on his desk 📁. He looks up, and suddenly, Jack is standing in front of him, smiling and confident 😊.

JACK:
"Thanks, Doc. I feel much better now." 🙏

DR. SMITH:
"Jack...where did you come from?" 🤔

JACK:
"I'm right here, Doc. I've always been here." 👀

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's been imagining the whole thing, and Jack is just a figment of his own paranoid delusions 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
"Oh no...I'm the one who's been sick all along." 😨

JACK:
"You're welcome, Doc. I've been taking care of you all along." 😊

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's face contorts in a mixture of horror and realization, the words "The Doctor is Crazy" emblazoned across the screen in bold letters 🤪.
